note: Human-verified band -> parking-zone assignments, applied by scripts/export-mobile-assets.mjs. An entry always wins over the automatic proposal, and an explicit null means 'this curb's zone is unknown' -- the app then reports occupancy but refuses to authorise parking, which is the honest answer when the law for that curb is not known. Verify against data/debug-<id>.jpg (npm run debug:overlay) plus Street View before adding a row: an automatic match is a heuristic over distance and apparent size, and cameras.json carries no camera pose, so pixels cannot be projected onto the ground. A confident wrong curb authorises parking inside a rush-hour ban.

fields.zoneId: id from data/zones.json, or null for 'unknown'
fields.sideKey: N | S | E | W, optional; defaults to the matched zone's blockSide
fields.nearness: near | far in the camera view, optional
fields.verifiedBy: how it was checked, e.g. 'streetview + data/debug-76.jpg'
